title: Bind Vault Helm deployment to an approved private ECR OCI manifest digest
classification_reason: ECR IAM and CodeBuild execution contract
expected_outcome: The approved Vault chart record includes its ECR OCI manifest digest, mirror re-runs verify it, and the bootstrap executor fails closed if the version tag resolves to any other manifest.
constraints: Only the reviewed private ECR chart manifest may be read.
Do not apply Terraform, invoke CodeBuild, access EKS/Vault/Kubernetes, initialize Vault, read secrets, deploy, merge, or change workflow permissions.

external_actions: read the private ECR chart manifest digest for the approved 0.31.0 tag

acceptance_checks: minimal schema and ECR path map
delegations.escalation_trigger: a design needs mutable chart selection, broad ECR access, or external deployment

validation: targeted chart and Terraform contract tests
